tokenName: Access Bank Zambia SME Digital Token
underlyingAsset: Small & Medium Enterprise portfolio of Access Bank Zambia
description: Tokenised SME loan portfolio of Access Bank Zambia. Each token represents a fractional share of diversified SME credit facilities issued under Zambia SME development policy.
regulatoryFramework: Zambia Banking Act; Central Bank SME Tokenisation Framework 2024

tokenName: Access Bank Zambia Warehouse Receipt Token
description: Warehouse receipt token issued by Access Bank Zambia against commodity stock deposited at certified warehouses in Zambia. Tradeable digital receipt on Algorand.
regulatoryFramework: Zambia Warehouse Receipts Act; Central Bank Commodity Tokenisation Guidelines

tokenName: Access Bank Zambia Agriculture Finance Token
description: Digital token representing agricultural credit facilities provided by Access Bank Zambia to smallholder farmers and cooperatives in Zambia.
regulatoryFramework: Zambia Agriculture Finance Act; Central Bank Green Finance Policy 2024
